releaseNotes:
WHAT'S NEW

- Bigger, wider game cards in Cover Flow view, easier to see at a glance.
- Game backgrounds: Cover Flow now shows an animated background behind the games. You can also set a custom video or GIF background for any individual game from the Edit screen.
- New Settings menu (gear icon, top right):
  - Change the keyboard shortcuts used to navigate and launch games.
  - Choose whether games launch on a single click or double click.
  - Set a custom default background video for Cover Flow, or reset it back to the built-in one.

No changes to how Add Game, Rescan, Search, or Delete work.
